exercises.description: Create keyword with optional default parameter values.
instructions: Call it twice: once with no args, once with 'Bob'
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Test Default Args
    # Call keyword with and without argument

*** Keywords ***
# Define keyword with default argument
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Test Default Args
    Greet
    Greet    Bob

*** Keywords ***
Greet
    [Arguments]    ${name}=Guest
    Log    Hello, ${name}!
hints: If not provided, default is used
Optional arguments come after required ones

exercises.title: Library Import with Name
exercises.description: Import library with alias using WITH NAME.
instructions: Import String library WITH NAME Str
Use 'Str.Convert To Upper Case' to convert 'hello' to uppercase
exercises.initialCode:
*** Settings ***
# Import library with alias

*** Test Cases ***
Test Library Alias
    # Use aliased library
exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Library    String    WITH NAME    Str

*** Test Cases ***
Test Library Alias
    ${result}    Str.Convert To Upper Case    hello
    Log    ${result}
hints: WITH NAME creates an alias for the library
Use alias.Keyword Name to call keywords
Useful when importing same library multiple times
